title: Kononenkogroup about
description: A studio profile on a 15-column grid: tiny serif-label / grotesk-value facts at the left, a 30px serif paragraph across the right two thirds, and a lower row of record lists (prizes, press) in tiny type with grey detail lines. On phones it stacks with a two-column fact grid. Every line rises from its mask as it enters.
notes: designed for two record lists; more lists alternate between the two list columns on wide screens
